name: Abisko-Abiskojaure
description: Abisko to Abiskojaure. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: STF says 15 km and 4-6 hours; Naturkartan says 14.0 km and 4-5 hours; AllTrails and OSM-derived sources are around 14-15 km. Use STF's 15 km / 4-6 h for official section display, and record 14.0 km Naturkartan linework distance as geometry metadata.
Official descriptions present Abiskojaure hut/cabin as the stage end, while Naturkartan notes hikers leave Kungsleden and cross Kamajakka by suspension bridge to reach the cabins.
Sources spell the mid-stage designated campsite as Nissonjohka, Nissunjohka, Nissunjakka/Nissunjåkka, and Nissonjåhka.

One AllTrails review from 2025-08-06 reported a bridge closure making the trail impassable without rerouting, but official sources checked on 2026-04-29 did not show a standing section closure and the bridge was not identified.
Naturkartan page linework is available in the web map/API evidence, but the public .gpx URL returned HTTP 500 on 2026-04-29 and the geometry agent found publish_gpx=false.

facilities.name: Kungsledsportalen / Kungsleden trailhead
facilities.description: Northern Kungsleden trailhead near Abisko Turiststation and Naturum Abisko.

facilities.name: Naturum Abisko
facilities.description: Visitor centre beside Abisko Turiststation with exhibitions, staffed reception during parts of the year, park information, sales of books/souvenirs and toilets listed in official park service information.
facilities.routeProximity: Start area, short walk from trailhead.

facilities.name: STF Abisko Turiststation
facilities.description: Major start-area facility with lodging, showers, toilets, guest kitchen, drying room, sauna, laundry, restaurant, cafe/basic cafe service, shop, equipment rental, parking and train/bus access.

facilities.name: STF Abiskojaure Mountain Cabin
facilities.description: First STF mountain cabin south of Abisko, by Lake Abiskojaure. STF lists 51-75 beds, guest kitchen, shop, sauna, cabin host in season and some pet rooms. Guests fetch water from stream or lake.
facilities.routeProximity: End of section; reached from the Kungsleden line by crossing Kamajakka suspension bridge.

facilities.name: Taltplats Abisko Turiststation
facilities.description: Designated national-park tent site at Abisko Turiststation, with service-building access; tent fee paid at station reception.

facilities.name: Taltplats Abiskojaure Cabins
facilities.description: Designated tent pitch adjacent to Abiskojaure cabins, with access to self-catering kitchen, sauna and latrine; tent fee paid to cabin warden.
facilities.routeProximity: End of section, adjacent to STF Abiskojaure Mountain Cabin.

facilities.name: Taltplats Nissonjohka
facilities.description: Designated tent and rest site just south of the Nissonjohka suspension bridge. Facilities reported from Naturkartan include wind shelter with benches, fireplaces, firewood and dry toilet.
facilities.routeProximity: On Kungsleden, about 5 km south of the main entrance.
